department: Graduate Program in Biomedical Sciences (College of Medicine)

deadline.value: November 1 priority application deadline for Fall semester admission
deadline.quote: The application deadline for admission to the UF College of Medicine Biomedical Sciences PhD at the Gainesville Campus is November 1st, in the year prior to the starting Fall semester.

gre_general.value: GRE is no longer required for acceptance to the Graduate Program in Biomedical Sciences.
gre_general.quote: GRE: The GRE is no longer required for acceptance to the University of Florida Graduate School OR for the Graduate Program in Biomedical Sciences.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no Biomedical Sciences subject test.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Students explore areas of study before choosing their mentor and concentration.
supervisor.quote: The BMS program is an umbrella Ph.D. program that offers students the opportunity to explore one or more areas of study before choosing their mentor and concentration of study.

funding.value: Admitted doctoral students receive stipend, tuition waiver, and health insurance.
funding.quote: Most entering graduate students are initially supported by a teaching assistantship, which pays the student’s tuition and provides a stipend.

entry_route.value: Direct admission from bachelor's degree with upper-division GPA of at least 3.0.
entry_route.quote: For applicants with solely a bachelor’s degree, a minimum 3.0 GPA on all coursework completed after the applicant has earned 60 semester hours (90 quarter hours) is required.
